sourceReview.reviewThrough: T1-52; bounded T1-53/54 identity setup, T1-55 DOB and T1-56 protected self-declared PAN deltas applied; bounded T1-57 financial XLSX template delta applied; bounded T1-58 insurance policy OCR delta applied; bounded T1-59 investment statement OCR delta applied; bounded T1-60 loan sanction letter OCR delta applied

definitions.Complete: Full original functionality delivered, separately from acceptance.
definitions.Partial: Usable subset exists and remaining functionality is identified.
definitions.Pending: Requested business journey is not delivered; foundations may exist.

deliverables.name: Registration
deliverables.existing: Organization onboarding and imported-customer ownership exist. T1-43 verifies existing customers only. T1-53 adds published, versioned account-agreement review/capture for existing owned customers. T1-54 adds opt-in guided setup and server financial-workspace admission derived from verified email, reviewed profile and current agreement acceptance.
deliverables.remaining: Complete public customer registration/activation and create the owned customer identity. Prove integrated email/database setup and supply approved legal content; T1-54 covers existing customer setup at the LOCAL product ingress only.

deliverables.name: Login
deliverables.existing: Existing imported customers can enter with an email verification code. Session activity and selected session termination are implemented.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the agreed customer authentication policy and activation coverage. Prove actual SMTP delivery and PostgreSQL session issuance/revocation.

deliverables.name: Profile
deliverables.existing: My Profile reads the registered email and edits display name and an optional unverified contact number, with versioned owner writes. T1-55 adds optional self-declared date of birth, exact calendar-date validation and owner receipt/readback. T1-56 adds optional self-declared PAN with authenticated encryption, masked owner readback, explicit replacement/removal and C&I audit metadata.
deliverables.remaining: Complete authoritative KYC status and remaining profile/Settings requirements under approved privacy rules. Self-declared PAN is not identity/KYC verification. Prove physical PostgreSQL persistence/replay/concurrency/grants and integrated UAT; production key custody/transport remain separate.

deliverables.name: Basic KYC
deliverables.existing: Customer identity and a RecordKycResult service-contract foundation exist. There is no completed customer KYC journey.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver the approved basic KYC evidence, status, review and customer experience. Enable any regulated route only under its existing approval.

deliverables.name: Upload
deliverables.existing: Customer-scoped original-byte upload, checksum/version identity, CSV intake and malware-check gate are implemented. T1-57 adds single-sheet financial-template XLSX original-byte intake through the same scan/hash/owner gates.
deliverables.remaining: Complete remaining required file-type/layout coverage, including legacy/arbitrary Excel only under an explicit scope. Verify live Docker/ClamAV benign and EICAR intake and durable original-byte storage.

deliverables.name: Document vault
deliverables.existing: Authorized library, document details, exact source links, processing activity and version history are implemented.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the specified document category taxonomy, metadata, storage/verification presentation and replacement/reindex journey.

deliverables.name: Classification
deliverables.existing: Strict salary-slip, loan-statement, insurance-policy, investment-statement and T1-60 loan-sanction-letter recognition across PNG, upright JPEG and single-page scanned PDF rejects multiple known titles.
deliverables.remaining: Cover the remaining §11 document classes and layouts, persist classification/unknown-review state, and expose the administration workflow.

deliverables.name: OCR
deliverables.existing: Real pinned OCR reads supported printed English salary slips, loan statements, insurance policies, investment statements and T1-60 loan sanction letters in PNG/JPEG and single-page scanned PDF.
deliverables.remaining: Expand the approved document/layout/page matrix and durable processing path. Prove browser-to-live-scanner-to-OCR integration.

deliverables.name: Extraction
deliverables.existing: Structured text/CSV supports seven source categories; supported OCR produces dated net-pay or loan-balance candidates for explicit review. T1-57 adds the same seven categories from a bounded financial XLSX template with original-byte provenance and explicit adoption. T1-58 insurance OCR adds distinctly labelled dated sum-assured and premium candidates; frequency, active cover and asset value are not inferred. T1-59 investment OCR adds distinct dated purchase-value/current-value candidates; no live price, gain/return or verified position/valuation is inferred. T1-60 sanction OCR adds distinct sanctioned-amount/EMI candidates dated by Sanction Date; no outstanding balance, disbursement or current-debt inference.
deliverables.remaining: Extract complete required domain records and remaining document classes. Preserve validation, original provenance and explicit adoption across durable owner services. Arbitrary Excel/bank layouts, formulas, numeric date serials and legacy/macro workbooks are unsupported.

deliverables.name: Indexing
deliverables.existing: Authorized lexical retrieval and derived search projections expose source-linked documents and reviewed figures.
deliverables.remaining: Complete durable document/financial/knowledge indexing as applicable, replacement/rebuild/invalidation and freshness handling across required document classes.

deliverables.name: Google Drive integration
deliverables.existing: Provider-neutral connector and consent foundations exist; no real customer Google Drive journey is evidenced.
deliverables.remaining: Implement approved OAuth, Monergy folder binding, exact provider file identity, import/status/refresh/disconnect and authorization revalidation.

deliverables.name: OneDrive integration
deliverables.existing: Provider-neutral connector and consent foundations exist; no real customer OneDrive journey is evidenced.
deliverables.remaining: Implement approved authorization, folder/file binding, import/status/refresh/disconnect and current consent enforcement.

deliverables.name: Income
deliverables.existing: Reviewed income source figures, source history, lexical Search, basic Reports and salary net-pay OCR are available.
deliverables.remaining: Complete §13 source/type/frequency/financial-year/verification fields and period-aware records. A dated net-pay amount is not a full income model.

deliverables.name: Expenses
deliverables.existing: Reviewed expense source figures, original provenance, Search and basic Reports are available through text/CSV.
deliverables.remaining: Complete expense category and period semantics, required record operations and comparable-period presentation.

deliverables.name: Assets
deliverables.existing: ASSET source figures have customer review, Passport/source drill-down, Search, basic Reports and coverage.
deliverables.remaining: Create authoritative asset records with ownership, type, dated value/valuation and liability relationships required for a meaningful asset position.

deliverables.name: Liabilities
deliverables.existing: LOAN source figures are reusable inputs. A dedicated complete liability record/customer journey is not delivered.
deliverables.remaining: Implement authoritative liability records, source/date/currency meaning and customer review. Do not infer total liabilities from arbitrary source figures.

deliverables.name: Loans
deliverables.existing: Reviewed LOAN source figures flow to Passport/Search/Reports; loan-statement OCR preserves dated outstanding or principal-outstanding meaning. T1-60 adds reviewed sanctioned-amount and EMI source terms from supported sanction letters without replacing an existing outstanding balance or completing loan records.
deliverables.remaining: Complete lender, loan type, sanction, outstanding, rate, EMI, tenure and start/end dates with full owner-backed records.

deliverables.name: Net worth
deliverables.existing: Financial Rules reference/simulator infrastructure exists. No customer-calculated sourced net worth is delivered.
deliverables.remaining: Implement Total Assets minus Total Liabilities from authoritative comparable dated/currency values, with lineage and insufficient-data handling.

deliverables.name: Income
deliverables.existing: Passport shows income-source coverage, counts, freshness and drill-down to reviewed items.
deliverables.remaining: Present the agreed meaningful income snapshot with comparable periods, provenance and incomplete-data states. Coverage counts do not represent income totals.

deliverables.name: Expenses
deliverables.existing: Passport shows expense-source coverage, counts, freshness and drill-down to reviewed items.
deliverables.remaining: Present the agreed meaningful expense snapshot using period/category semantics, provenance and incomplete-data states.

deliverables.name: Liabilities
deliverables.existing: Loan-information coverage is visible, but it does not establish or display the full liability position.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver the liability snapshot from authoritative liability records with dated values, provenance and completeness indicators.

deliverables.name: Assets
deliverables.existing: Passport and Action Centre expose asset-source coverage and source-linked reviewed figures.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver a meaningful asset-position snapshot using dated ownership/value records, valuation context and completeness handling.

deliverables.name: Financial document search
deliverables.existing: Authorized lexical customer Search covers documents and seven reviewed source categories with original source links.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the §15 natural-language query journey and relevant retrieval across the required indexed document classes.

deliverables.name: Basic financial Q&A
deliverables.existing: Search and source provenance are reusable foundations. A customer grounded-answer experience is not delivered.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver authorized financial Q&A with source citations, deterministic calculations, validation, audit and insufficient-data behavior within the approved model/privacy boundary.

deliverables.name: Financial summary
deliverables.existing: Customer basic Reports and JSON export summarize reviewed source figures from seven categories.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the basic AI financial-summary experience grounded in authoritative comparable records, with explanation, citations and no unsupported totals.

deliverables.name: Customer management
deliverables.existing: Organization onboarding, imported people and RBAC exist. These do not deliver the administrator customer lifecycle workspace.
deliverables.remaining: Implement authorized customer list/detail/lifecycle operations with meaningful customer identities, audit and tenant boundaries.

deliverables.name: Document monitoring
deliverables.existing: The customer Documents activity view and service metadata exist; the administrator operating journey is not delivered.
deliverables.remaining: Implement authorized document/classification/scan/processing monitoring and the explicitly scoped recovery actions.

deliverables.name: Processing status
deliverables.existing: Workers/job states and customer processing activity exist. There is no complete administrator processing-status workspace.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver administrator queues, required job states, failure/retry visibility and authorized recovery with exact operation receipts.

deliverables.name: Audit log
deliverables.existing: Canonical Audit integration and Access activity exist. The complete Phase 1 product audit-log operating journey is not delivered.
deliverables.remaining: Expose authorized product-wide sensitive-event search/filter/detail/export and prove required identity, outcome and source fields across Phase 1 events.
